implied_expectations.price_basis: US$357.16, close 2026-09-03 (down 2.74% on the day, following the Q3 FY2026 release on 2026-09-02 after which the stock fell about 6.5% after hours). Market price is a tier-4 input; the share count is tier-1.
implied_expectations.shares_basis: FACT (tier-1): 4,758M issued and outstanding at 2026-05-03 per the Q2 FY2026 10-Q balance sheet.
implied_expectations.net_debt_derivation: FACT (tier-1): total debt principal outstanding $66,720M less cash and equivalents $19,628M at 2026-05-03.

segments_usd_m.note: Semiconductor revenue grew 78.5% YoY in Q2 FY2026 while infrastructure software grew only 8.8%. The two-engine story is becoming a one-engine story.

q3_fy2026_and_guidance.source: Q3 FY2026 results released 2026-09-02, post-dating all supplied filings. Headline figures only — no GAAP income statement available.

customer_concentration_pct.note: The most extreme concentration trajectory in this harness — worse than NVDA's 12% to 22% top-customer move and TSM's 19%.

share_count_millions.note: RISING, uniquely in this harness (Samsung -1.24%, NVDA -2.3%). H1 FY2026 buybacks of $8,450M did not prevent a 17M increase. Most of the multi-year rise was the 544M shares issued as VMware currency.

balance_sheet_2025_11_02_usd_m.note: Goodwill plus intangibles is 76% of assets; goodwill alone exceeds book equity by roughly $16.5B, so tangible book value is deeply negative.

earnings_quality_adjustment.gaap_to_non_gaap_gap_pp: approximately 20 percentage points of operating margin
earnings_quality_adjustment.components: SBC around 10-12% of revenue plus acquisition intangible amortisation around 9-10%
earnings_quality_adjustment.why_it_matters: Roughly half the add-back is SBC, which is a real cost — demonstrably so, because the share count is rising despite $8,450M of H1 buybacks. Every valuation test in this file therefore uses GAAP, with the non-GAAP figure shown alongside.

multiples.estimate_warning: BOTH ARE ESTIMATES. Q3 FY2026 GAAP earnings were not available — only headline revenue and adjusted EPS. The GAAP build assumes roughly 50% and 52% GAAP operating margins in Q3 and Q4 and carries material uncertainty.

reverse_engineered_requirement.method: Solve for the GAAP net income that justifies $1,699B at a range of mature multiples, then compare with the FY2026 estimated base of roughly $45B.
reverse_engineered_requirement.at_25x: requires roughly $68B — about 51% above the FY2026 estimate
reverse_engineered_requirement.conclusion: At 30x GAAP the price requires roughly 27% growth beyond the FY2026 estimated base. With Q4 guided at +93% revenue YoY that is reachable, so the gap is POSITIVE — but it is the thinnest of the four names, because a 38x GAAP starting multiple already discounts much of what the guidance makes visible.

bear.narrative: The 42% customer in-sources, re-bids its XPU programme to Marvell, or halves its order as hyperscaler capex digests. Infrastructure software stays ex-growth at single digits. Leverage of about $47.1B amplifies the earnings decline, and a goodwill impairment against a deeply negative tangible book becomes plausible.
bear.note: The infrastructure software base — roughly $28B of revenue at a 78% margin — is the floor and is genuinely sticky. Without it the bear would be worse.

base.narrative: The XPU franchise persists across two or three hyperscaler programmes, AI semiconductor revenue plateaus at a high level rather than compounding, and infrastructure software grows in the mid single digits. Margins hold near current levels.

bull.narrative: Custom silicon becomes the dominant AI compute paradigm. Broadcom adds programmes beyond its current base, networking attach compounds alongside XPU, and the company captures a durable share of accelerator value.

permanent_loss_case.definition: Permanent impairment of more than 70% of capital, not a drawdown.
permanent_loss_case.required_conditions: Requires the 42% customer relationship to be lost or halved AND the software franchise to erode, with roughly $47.1B of net debt amplifying the decline and a goodwill impairment eliminating book equity.
permanent_loss_case.why_low_but_not_negligible: Operating cash flow of $27,537M against $2,672M of cash interest gives roughly 10x coverage, and infrastructure software provides a high-margin floor. But leverage and 42% single-customer dependence make this tail fatter than NVDA's.

subjective_probabilities.labelled: EXPLICITLY SUBJECTIVE — analyst judgement, not derived from data.
subjective_probabilities.sensitivity_warning: Dominated by the bear weight, which is really a judgement about the durability of one customer relationship at 42% of revenue. At bear 0.20 / base 0.50 / bull 0.30 the weighted return rises to roughly +25%; at bear 0.40 the figure turns slightly negative. The verdict is sensitive across that range, which is itself the argument for waiting on the concentration disclosure.

notes: Step order per agents/valuation.md: reverse expectations first, then scenarios, then asymmetry, then score. No target price used as a starting point. FY2025 and H1 FY2026 figures are tier-1 from the 10-K and 10-Q; Q3 FY2026 and Q4 guidance are from the 2026-09-02 release, which post-dates the supplied filings and is headline-only. The FY2026 GAAP earnings build is the ANALYST'S OWN ESTIMATE and is the weakest input in this file. Valuation is assessed on GAAP because roughly half the non-GAAP add-back is SBC, which is demonstrably a real cost — the share count rose despite $8,450M of H1 repurchases.
